hi: यार, मैं कल से ट्राई कर रहा हूँ, द पेमेंट डिडन्ट गो थ्रू।
literal: Yaar, I am trying since yesterday, the payment didn't go through.
fluent: I've been trying since yesterday, but the payment didn't go through.

hi: मैंने तीन बार ट्राई किया, हर बार एरर आ रहा है।
literal: I tried three times, every time an error is coming.
fluent: I tried three times and got an error every time.

hi: अंकित ने बोला था कि इट वोन्ट बी अ प्रॉब्लम, पर अभी भी कुछ नहीं हुआ।
literal: Ankit had said that it won't be a problem, but still nothing has happened.
fluent: Ankit said it wouldn't be a problem, but nothing has happened yet.

hi: बारह लाख का इनवॉइस है, क्लाइंट वेट कर रहा है।
literal: It is a twelve lakh invoice, the client is waiting.
fluent: It's a ₹12 lakh invoice and the client is waiting.

hi: कैन यू प्लीज़ एस्केलेट दिस टू योर सीनियर?
literal: Can you please escalate this to your senior?
fluent: Can you please escalate this to your senior?

literal: I need some update by this evening, otherwise the deal will get cancelled.
